claims.statement: Under the full target hypotheses, for a partner coherent compact-cell physical triple with m=3501/8000, after relabeling its largest diagonal as a and defining d=b-x^2/a, f=c-y^2/a, e=z-xy/a, either an original physical pair/triple gives ||p_Q||_infinity<866, or the exact rank-one subtraction leaves a triple Schur residual of operator norm <1/8 and forces either s_2(A[O,O])>=1/2 or ||A[T,O]||_op>1/2.

With theta=1/20, if |b-x^2/a|>=theta or |c-y^2/a|>=theta, the corresponding physical pair is paid by definite coarea or the full-matrix indefinite-pair theorem; if both are <theta but |det M|>=m theta^2, the account03/B20 physical-triple estimate pays the branch.

Given the source-realizable external packet s_2(A[O,O])>=1/2 or ||A[T,O]||_op>1/2 after the coherent-triangle rank-one subtraction, prove one universal L-infinity density bound or reduce source-validly to an already-paid grouped/ridge/pair packet.
